PLAN "12-Week Couch to 5K Plan with Strength, Pace, Intervals, Tempo Day, Parkrun Test, Finisher/Race-Day Prep, and Summary"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "build base conditioning, cardiovascular readiness for 5K, tempo development, interval training competence, Parkrun test integration, finisher/race-day prep, and foundational strength while accommodating exercise-induced asthma"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Intro to easy runs with warmups, intro strength, tempo day, and intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          walking_run 1x60 seconds rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          jogging 5 minutes
          calf_stretch 30 seconds
        strength_training:
          push_up 3x8 rpe 7
          dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 7
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 7
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 7
          plank 3x20 seconds
        interval_training:
          run 1x60 seconds rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
        tempo_training:
          run 1x120 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Walk-to-Jog progression with strength, tempo day":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run 2x60 seconds rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
        strength_training:
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 7
          bent_over_row 3x8 rpe 7
          split_squat 3x8 per leg rpe 7
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7
          side_plank 3x20 seconds per side
        tempo_training:
          run 1x60 seconds rpe 5
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Intro to continuous movement with light strength - tempo increases slightly":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          shoulder_stretch 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run 3x60 seconds rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
        strength_training:
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 7
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 7
          leg_extension 2x12 rpe 7
          standing_calf_raise 2x15 rpe 7
          hollow_hold 3x20 seconds
        interval_training:
          jog_in_place 2x30 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        tempo_training:
          run 1x60 seconds rpe 5
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Increase run intervals with strength blocks - tempo up + intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run 4x90 seconds rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          jogging 5 minutes
        strength_training:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 7
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 7
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 7
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 7
          plank 3x30 seconds
        interval_training:
          run 4x60 seconds rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        tempo_training:
          run 1x120 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Consistency with gains - pace modestly increased on running sets":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 2x60 seconds rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
        strength_training:
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 7
          dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 7
          split_squat 3x8 per leg rpe 7
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7
          farmer_walk 2x30 seconds
        interval_training:
          run 2x60 seconds rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        tempo_training:
          run 1x60 seconds rpe 5
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 50m "Progression test with core work - slightly faster final rep":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          light mobility 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 3x90 seconds rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
        strength_training:
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 7
          chin_up 3x5 rpe 7
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7
          cable_row 3x8 rpe 7
          bicycle_crunch 3x20 seconds
        interval_training:
          run 4x30 seconds all-out? no not allowed; use rpe 7 for 30s with 90s rest
        tempo_training:
          run 1x60 seconds rpe 5
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Endurance with progressive strength - push pace on last interval + intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          dynamic mobility 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 4x2 minutes rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
        strength_training:
          bench_press 3x6 rpe 7
          barbell_row 3x6 rpe 7
          back_extension 3x12 rpe 7
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 7
          planks 3x40 seconds
        interval_training:
          run 6x1 minute rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        tempo_training:
          run 2x60 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Tempo runs with strength maintenance - pace up slightly + intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 3x3 minutes rpe 5 rest 150 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
        strength_training:
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 7
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 7
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 7
          leg_extension 2x12 rpe 7
          side_plank 3x25 seconds per side
        interval_training:
          run 5x30 seconds fast with 60 seconds jog
        tempo_training:
          run 1x60 seconds rpe 5
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Intervals + core focus - faster pace on repeats":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 5x2 minutes rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
        strength_training:
          arnold_press 3x8 rpe 7
          cable_row 3x8 rpe 7
          split_squat 3x8 per leg rpe 7
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7
          ab_wheel 3x6
        interval_training:
          run 6x1 minute rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        tempo_training:
          run 1x60 seconds rpe 5
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Parkrun Test Week - simulate official 5K event cadence":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 6x1 minute rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
        strength_training:
          push_up 3x12 rpe 7
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 7
          bent_over_row 3x10 rpe 7
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 7
          hollow_hold 3x30 seconds
        interval_training:
          run 1x5 minutes rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
        tempo_training:
          run 2x60 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 65m "5K readiness with strength taper - Parkrun-style test cadence":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          jog_in_place 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 6x2 minutes rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
        strength_training:
          push_up 3x12 rpe 7
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 7
          bent_over_row 3x10 rpe 7
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 7
          hollow_hold 3x30 seconds
        interval_training:
          run 6x1 minute rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        tempo_training:
          run 2x60 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Cadence practice with mobility - pace up on tempo segments":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          leg_stretch 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          run 3x3 minutes rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
        strength_training:
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 7
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7
          pallof_press 3x12
        interval_training:
          run 4x30 seconds fast with 60 seconds jog
        tempo_training:
          run 1x60 seconds rpe 5
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Race-day prep finisher - taper week end simulation":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          jog_in_place 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 2x5 minutes rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
        strength_training:
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 7
          pull_up 3x4 rpe 7
          leg_extension 2x12 rpe 7
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 7
          plank 3x45 seconds

NOTES:
- Parkrun weeks integrated as practical benchmarks around Phase 3 and Phase 4. Maintain asthma-first approach: carry reliever inhaler, pace to conversational levels when needed, and adjust intervals if symptoms arise. If Parkrun is not feasible, substitute a controlled 5K tempo/distance test within Phase 4.
- Finisher/Race-Day prep week is designed to taper and sharpen race-day cadence while preserving strength stimulus. Ensure proper warmups and breath-control strategies, and keep inhaler accessible.
